s.en: Email reminders from your DSH agent when you're away — fires at goal completion, blockage, before asking the user a decision, and at long-task milestones.
Bridge OpenCode CLI free models into dsh (no OpenCode login needed) via an llm adapter

DeepSeek Harness plugin: first-class Git workflow tools for the model — repo status, diffs, commit creation with validated messages, recent history, and branches. No bare-shell git calls; every invocation is a shell-free execFile with path and message val

DeepSeek Harness plugin: Claude-Code-style lifecycle hooks for DSH. Configure shell commands that run automatically before/after model tool calls (pre-tool / post-tool) with a JSON payload on stdin; pre-tool non-zero exits block the call.

DeepSeek Harness plugin: cross-session memory for the model. Full-text search all past sessions (SQLite FTS5 via ctx.sessionQuery) and bring the strongest matching excerpts back into the current context — recall earlier decisions, commands, and mistakes.
DeepSeek Harness plugin for ecommerce operators: CSV batch tools, reproducible scoring, Chinese skills and store policy KB.
U同步 / Uagent Sync — cross-device workspace sync for DeepSeek Harness: backup, restore, and ecosystem update via the uagent-sync CLI.
Orbis remote plugin for DeepSeek Harness
Theme picker plugin for deepseek-harness themes: registers all themes, adds a settings row, and persists third-party selection

Open-source plugin market for the DSH web GUI: card grid with GitHub stars, last-commit freshness, and one-click install/uninstall. The catalog is this repo's own data/plugins.json — anyone can add a plugin via pull request. · 开源 DSH 插件市场：卡片式排布、星数、最近提交、一键
The DSH Market client: a sidebar for browsing, searching, recommendations, one-click install, and managing what you have installed. Core logic lives in @dsh-market/core.

s.en: Puts a small animated face in front of the "Deep diving…" state — a GrokBot-style avatar in pure SVG and rAF, ported from nasawz/GrokBot with no runtime dependencies, or an emoji carousel instead.

s.en: Ready-made Chinese agent presets applied to the official set in one click: a Xiaohongshu notes assistant, a copy-polishing preset, and a daily and weekly report generator.

s.en: 151 AionUi skins with a try-on panel for the DSH web UI.
s.zh: 151 款 AionUi 皮肤聚合 + 皮肤中心试穿面板 / A 151-skin pack with a try-on panel for DSH Web UI.

GUI settings card for dsh-subagent-effort: choose the subagent model and reasoning effort in Settings 鈥?no config files to edit.
Git tab for DeepSeek Harness: repo overview, file status, commit history, branch view, git init and git operations — powered by gmc.
DeepSeek account balance readout docked under the composer for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — a persistent web plugin.

DeepSeek API balance pill for the DSH Web GUI: shows remaining credit in the left sidebar footer with low-balance alerts, spend history, and a one-click top-up link. The API key never leaves the host process — the host half resolves it through the dsh cre

DSH Web UI plugin: listens to GitHub issues/PRs across the account's repositories, auto-fixes issues whose repos are checked out locally, and turns PRs / feature requests / other items into a review-and-run queue with one-click agent execution and push.
Import Claude Code config (skills / rules / CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md) into DeepSeek Harness, with destination preview, conflict strategies, and idempotent re-imports.

Migrates a Claude setup to dsh: drop .claude/skills, .claude/rules, .mcp.json, and CLAUDE.md into the plugin directory and they load as dsh capabilities, with a dashboard covering skills, rules, MCP servers, and connection status.

s.en: An iOS-style stat bar under the composer: expand it for session spend, account balance, cache hits, and token usage.
s.zh: DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方的 iOS 风格统计条：一键展开查看会话花费、账户余额、缓存命中与 Token 用量。

s.en: DeepSeek API quota widget for the dsh web GUI: shows remaining DeepSeek API balance in a floating card pinned to the bottom-right corner (shell.overlay slot).
Drag files into the DeepSeek Harness web GUI and send them with your message, absolute paths included.

s.en: Runtime guard: snapshots a good configuration once startup succeeds, and if a plugin later fails to load it rolls back to the last good snapshot and restarts.
s.zh: DSH 运行期守护：启动成功后自动存档；插件加载失败时自动回退到上次良好快照并重启。

s.en: High-reliability Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness — QR one-click auth, multi-mode agents, card-based commands, zero-loss outbox, media in/out, session logs, reusable DSH Web GUI

NewAPI (OpenAI-compatible gateway) chat-completions adapter for the DeepSeek Harness LLM seam. Provider route id 'newapi', display name 'NewAPI'. Dual-face: host half registers the LLM adapter and chat-only model discovery; browser half adds a NewAPI sett
DSH lorebook-driven fiction writer plugin: import Tavern/SillyTavern character cards & world books, save local Markdown lore documents, and generate novel prose with the world settings as reference.
Plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness Web: browse, search, install and remove DSH plugins right from the Plugins settings section.

Monitors OpenCode Go subscription usage from a badge pinned at the bottom of the sidebar — five-hour, weekly, and monthly percentages, turning red on anomalies. Click for a detail card with reset countdowns, trends, alerts, and key configuration; sudden spikes or overruns are flagged so a stolen key does not go unnoticed.
s.zh: OpenCode Go 订阅用量监控：侧边栏底部常驻徽标（5h/周/月百分比，异常标红），点击在左侧弹出详情卡片（重置倒计时、趋势、告警、Key 配置），用量突增/超标标红提醒（防额度被他人盗刷）。

s.en: Trae-style withdraw for DeepSeek Harness Web: a rollback button on every user/assistant message that restores the workspace code (git commits or hard-link file snapshots) and forks the session back to the last completed turn. 会话撤回插件：每条消息一键回滚代码与对话。
A safety net for hands-off runs: directory deletions go to the trash first, and deletions never follow symlinks. No approvals, no dialogs.
s.zh: 脱手模式安全网：删除目录先进回收站、删除链接绝不跟随。零审批、零弹窗。

s.en: A dark-gold particle skin for the dsh web GUI: a dark gold ground, drifting gold particles, and warm off-white type.
s.zh: Dark-gold particle skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: 暗金背景 + 漂浮金色粒子 + 暖白黄文字

s.en: A collapsible A-share watchlist in the top right of the dsh web UI, with intraday and candlestick charts, target prices, theme switching, dragging, and grouped tickers.
s.zh: A股自选股实时行情盯盘插件 - DeepSeek Harness Web 右上角可折叠弹窗（分时/K线/目标价/主题切换/可拖动/添加股票分组）

s.en: A Nachoneko (甘城猫猫) themed skin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, featuring the artist's artwork as the wallpaper background.
Appearance and theming: a built-in palette, search and import from Open VSX, a colour parameter editor, and independent light and dark assignments.
s.zh: DSH 外观与主题插件:内置调色板、Open VSX 搜索导入、颜色参数编辑器、明暗独立归属

Persistent vision plugin for DeepSeek Harness: registers the vision_analyze tool backed by a configurable multimodal model, with a settings-page UI. Zero dependencies.
A full vision kit: the vision_understand tool against any OpenAI-compatible vision API, defaulting to the free Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash, plus three ways in — paste, drag, or a button.
s.zh: DeepSeek Harness 视觉能力全家桶：vision_understand 工具（OpenAI 兼容视觉 API，默认免费智谱 GLM-4V-Flash）+ 粘贴/拖拽/按钮三入口识图

s.en: Rotates the app wallpaper on a timer with a cross-fade, ships an SVG wallpaper set, and exposes readability controls — frosted glass, dimming, text shadow, and background opacity — from a settings page.
s.zh: DSH 壁纸轮换插件：定时轮换应用背景壁纸（交叉淡化动效），内置 SVG 壁纸集，毛玻璃/压暗/文字阴影/背景不透明度等可读性调节，设置页可配置。

s.en: Persistent WebUI authentication plugin for DeepSeek Harness: configure an account/password in Settings, then accessing the WebUI requires login. Zero dependencies.
Bridge WeChat (iLink bot) to DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
A Skins panel in the sidebar that takes a local image or a URL as a full-screen background, with presets, dimming, blur, and an off switch, persisted across reloads.
s.zh: DSH Web GUI 皮肤插件：侧栏「皮肤」面板，支持自选本地图片 / URL 作为全屏背景，含预设、暗化、模糊、关闭皮肤，跨刷新持久化（外部 client 插件，dsh-web-ui 风格）。

s.en: A rocket-launch mission panel on the right of the web GUI: the last month of launches summarised, details on hover, collapsible to an arrow.
s.zh: DSH Web GUI 右侧的火箭发射任务面板：近一月发射汇总 + 悬停详情，可折叠为左箭头

s.en: Kitchen & life assistant board for DeepSeek Harness: an official profile bundle adding webServer host routes and a dsh.client browser board with a five-step init wizard and a configurable working directory
DSH plugin: a draggable workbench of mini-cards (API balance, token usage, session stats, goal, cost estimate) beside the conversation
Find DeepSeek Harness plugins inside the agent — live GitHub dsh-plugin topic search, ranked by stars.
Route DeepSeek Harness agent requests by role: planner model in plan mode, default model otherwise, subagent model for subagents.
Complete reverse-skill (85 skills) as a DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin — reverse engineering, authorized pentesting and security research skill router pack.
DeepSeek wallet-balance readout at the sidebar foot: card icon + amount, status-tinted, refreshed on turn end and on click, with a floating delta animation on change
Bounded autonomous orchestration and dynamic Cordis self-extension for DeepSeek Harness
Expose DeepSeek Harness agent capabilities as an MCP server, so an external MCP client (e.g. Hermes) can drive Harness to execute coding tasks. Hermes = brain, Harness = arms.
DSH All-in-One：一键安装 DeepSeek Harness 第一方最佳插件全家桶（商店 / 通知 / 会话导出 / 任务板）。One-command install of the curated first-party DSH plugin suite (plugin-manager store / notify / session-export / team-board).
Track Bridge: embedded task-management engine for DeepSeek Harness — decision-point protocol, capture wall, and Linear-shaped issue store over session events + storage KV

DeepSeek Harness plugin: installs the 'minimal-gitbash' agent preset — the Windows variant of the shipped minimal preset that routes the bash tool through Git for Windows bash (MSYS), with automatic shell discovery and sandbox-aware gating.
Cross-session memory that lets the agent remember your project context, decisions, and preferences.
s.zh: 跨会话记忆系统 —— 让 AI Agent 记住你的项目上下文、决策和偏好

s.en: A code quality gate that checks syntax, startup paths, APIs, and cross-system dependencies.
s.zh: 代码质量门禁 —— 智能检查代码语法、启动链、API 和跨系统关联

CHIRAL PULSE - a Death Stranding-styled BB pod vital-signs monitor for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: the session's heartbeat waveform is the hero, and the pulse reacts to real agent activity.

A-share stock selection and portfolio diagnosis across four strategies — ultra-short, short, medium, and long term — built on a-stock-data with 47 data endpoints. Every answer carries a mandatory risk disclaimer.
s.zh: A股选股与持仓诊断 DSH 插件：四大策略（超短线/短线/中线/长线）+ 持仓诊断，基于 a-stock-data 开发，内置 47 个数据端点，输出强制风险提示

s.en: ADB device & bench operations for DeepSeek Harness: device discovery, structured logcat, apk install, file pull/push, performance snapshots
DeepSeek Harness web widget: API balance badge with today/month token usage, cache-hit donut chart and cost estimate. Hosts GET /api-balance and injects a bottom-right badge into the dsh web UI.
Automatic approval gating: a Flash model predicts whether a write or command is irreversible, auto-approving what is safe and escalating what is not. Fail-safe by design.
s.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自动审批门控：Flash 模型预判写入/命令是否不可回补，安全自动批准、危险转人工（fail-safe）

s.en: CI doctor plugin for DeepSeek Harness: watch GitHub Actions failures, diagnose logs into structured findings, and drive the fix loop
DeepSeek Harness plugin: bridge Claude Code's .claude/ directory (skills, commands, rules) into DSH native skill registry and message-stream rules injection.

Real-time code feedback for DeepSeek Harness — LSP, linters, formatters, type-checking, and structural analysis.
MCP adapter for DeepSeek Harness — one proxy tool instead of dumping every MCP schema into context.
Security audit plugin for DeepSeek Harness: static permission profiling and a runtime sentinel for third-party plugins
A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that greets the user at the start of every session with varied wording, learns their name on first use, and greets them personally afterward.
mm-vision (通感编码器) for DeepSeek Harness — give any text-only LLM the ability to see images via structured spatial text encoding. Registers the mm_vision tool.
dsh Web GUI remote access: bind the webserver to 0.0.0.0 for LAN/remote access and inject the crypto.randomUUID polyfill for non-secure HTTP origins.
DeepSeek Harness bundle plugin for SCNet (scnet.cn) and similar domestic HPC clusters: SSH setup, Slurm job generation, cluster probing, and Hygon DCU/DTK guidance.
Benchmark-driven self-evolution plugin for DeepSeek Harness: evaluate, optimize, snapshot, accept or roll back.

s.en: Local-first vision for text-only DeepSeek Harness agents: route image understanding to a local OpenAI-compatible vision model, return structured JSON evidence (summary / OCR / layout / semantics / visual / uncertainty).
Web access for DeepSeek Harness — multi-provider search/fetch on ctx.web, plus GitHub/PDF/YouTube extraction.
Superpowers for the DeepSeek Harness: TDD, debugging, planning, and collaboration skills adapted from obra/superpowers

Talk to Excel in DeepSeek Harness: create/edit spreadsheets, formulas, styles, filters, and tables by conversation; auto-verifies formulas after every edit, repairs silent errors, and validates charts.
PDF toolbox for DeepSeek Harness: extract text, metadata, and page ranges from PDF files (local parsing, no API key).
Weather tool for DeepSeek Harness: current conditions and multi-day forecasts via Open-Meteo (free, no API key).

Shared real browser capability for DeepSeek Harness: a visible browser the human watches and can take over, driven by the agent over CDP (snapshot/execute/content/tab management); host-side seam, provider, and browser_* tools
Git capability bundle for DeepSeek Harness: structured git tools, approval-gated mutations, and auto-checkpoints.
Tavily search provider bundle for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): registers a WebSearchProvider into ctx.web
Brave Search-backed WebSearchProvider for the DeepSeek Harness web seam (ctx.web)
Tavily-backed WebSearchProvider for the DeepSeek Harness web seam (ctx.web) - keyless mode supported, no API key required

DeepSeek Harness plugin: web browsing tools (markdown / screenshot / pdf) powered by Cloudflare Browser Run — real headless Chrome with JS rendering, login sessions and WebMCP support.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: Nocturne Memory client — automated long-term memory (boot/read/search/create/update) backed by your own Nocturne MCP server.

Something to do while the model thinks: a small game menu pops up in the bottom right during generation — Wordle and a match-three, with an extensible game registry.
s.zh: 贪玩蓝鲸 — 模型生成时右下角弹出小游戏菜单（wordle / 消消乐，可拓展游戏注册表）

s.en: Exposes run_python and run_node tools with configurable interpreter paths; settings card (via /interpreters/api HTTP route) lets users set the executable locations.
DSH plugin exposing MinerU document parsing tools to the model, with a web UI settings page for the API base URL.
A braided whip (辫子) hanging in the chat-flow — grab the tip and swing to send "go work!" to the agent.
Two-level DSH workspace sidebar with global recent sessions and breadcrumb navigation.
Configurable subagent profiles with web UI settings, real-time toolcall/token display, and click-to-navigate child sessions.
Optional Web UI enhancements for DeepSeek Harness
DSH plugin exposing a single `sleep` tool that lets the model pause for a configurable number of milliseconds, honoring cancellation.

User authentication for the dsh web UI: username and password, generic OAuth 2.0 with templates for GitHub, Google, and Discord, and Solana or EVM wallet login. A zero-dependency core wired entirely through configuration.

Unofficial DeepSeek Harness LLM provider plugin for Command Code, ported from pi-commandcode-provider (MIT). Registers the 'commandcode' provider route with a Models-page card and live model catalog.

Design I/O for coding agents: controllable UI generation via declarations (spec/domain/craft/design/components/template) and contracts (skill/evaluator). Use for product UI—console, dashboard, agent-ops, CJK-first apps.
GitHub integration for DeepSeek Harness: create pull requests, review PRs with background jobs, and read issues — every write gated by human approval

Curated, verified MCP server bundle for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): one install brings demo, memory, filesystem, GitHub, Playwright and remote HTTP MCP servers, with a connectivity verifier and CI checks.
DSH web plugin: a real-time dashboard tab for the current conversation — token usage, cache hit rate, message-role distribution, and timing breakdowns, visualized.
DeepSeek Harness ACP bundle for editor delegation: a one-command Agent Client Protocol stdio server profile that shares dsh credentials and session logs.

A desktop-native BigFish companion driven by DeepSeek Harness session events.

DeepSeek Harness plugin that uses configured model providers for image analysis and context compaction.

Terminal-style input history for the DeepSeek Harness web composer: edge-first arrows with exact draft/caret restore, browser-local persisted history, Ctrl+R reverse search, workspace-scoped recall, and fully configurable keys — plus sliding-context aware
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: live conversation cost and DeepSeek account balance in the composer stats row — RMB in Chinese UI, USD in English UI
DSH web plugin: per-workspace background, chat font size, line height, block spacing, and Retina font rendering.

Subagent Director: choose an LLM provider/model for each subagent (call args > role binding > plugin default > inherit parent) and plan main-agent/subagent responsibilities with role templates, plus a settings UI.
Safe delete plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): move files to trash / staging area instead of permanent removal, with restore and purge support.

s.zh: dsh-yolo-mode —— DeepSeek Harness 双面包插件：当会话处于可写沙箱模式且审批策略为 ask 时，用大模型自动裁决沙箱升权申请，支持内置预设与自定义权限层级，并提供宿主 settings + 自发布设置桥（/yolo-mode）与 Web 客户端 UI。

s.en: TEST PUBLISH of @memorylake/dsh-plugin — do not depend on this package

DeepSeek Harness bundle: adds AI NetCafé's hosted outcome tools to your dsh profile in one install — invoice batches and bank statements that arithmetic-check themselves, SQL dialect transpile, mainland-China reachability from a real China Mobile vantage
DeepSeek Harness Web question-anchor plugin: a right-side floating panel listing every user question in the current conversation; clicking an item smoothly scrolls the chat to that message
OpenCode Go statusline for dsh web: context usage, Go subscription usage, working directory
Session ergonomics: /new for a fresh session, ↑↓ through your input history, and Ctrl+C to stop a session.
s.zh: DSH 会话人体工学：/new 一键新会话 + 输入历史 ↑↓ 回溯 + Ctrl+C 终止会话

s.en: A plugin marketplace inside the web UI: browse github.com/topics/dsh-plugin from the settings page, search it, sort by stars, and see how to install each one.
s.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 内置插件市场：在设置页直接浏览 github.com/topics/dsh-plugin，支持搜索、按 Star 排序、查看安装方式。

s.en: soul.md-style persona cards: injects a markdown persona file into the system prompt as soul:persona and hot-reloads it on change, so the agent stays in character while it works. Adds a settings panel.
s.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 soul.md 风格人设卡插件：把 markdown 人设文件注入系统提示词（soul:persona），文件变更热重载，让 Agent 边干活边角色扮演；附 Web UI 设置栏。

s.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web plugin: API balance + today's spend widget in the sidebar footer. /api/dsh-usage route + React client bundle, no build step required.

DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web plugin: API balance + today's spend sidebar widget, /api/dsh-usage route, external vision-call accounting (JSONL usage log), plus a full per-session usage dashboard (call log, per-model stats, cache rate, CSV export) via the usa
DeepSeek Harness (dsh) bundle wiring SkillRoute's skill router into your agents.

The opencode_usage tool queries opencode.ai's official usage API live — rolling five-hour, weekly, and monthly percentages with reset times. The API key is found automatically from the opencode auth file, the environment, or plugin config, so there is nothing to sign into.
s.zh: OpenCode Go 套餐用量查询插件：opencode_usage 工具实时查询 opencode.ai 官方用量 API（滚动 5h / 每周 / 每月三个窗口的用量百分比与重置时间），API key 自动从 opencode 认证文件 / 环境变量 / 插件配置解析，无需额外登录。

s.en: DeepSeek Harness IM bridge plugin: route Telegram & WeChat messages into per-peer agent sessions and reply back
Desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness: approval / completion / error events with click-to-open deep links into the Web GUI.
DSH skin plugin: Alphacoders popular wallpapers as the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI background (gallery, search, local upload, per-theme wallpapers, favorites, auto-change, history)
Token cost tracking for DeepSeek Harness: per-session and per-message cost projection with a web summary surface. Official DeepSeek prices are synced automatically by a daily script.

A plugin store built on npm as the authoritative source (250+ plugins), validated against the dsh manifest fields and enriched with GitHub stars. Install and uninstall in one click — it merges cordis.patch.yml for you — and restart to apply.
s.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件商店：npm 权威源聚合（250+ 插件）+ dsh 字段质量验证 + GitHub 星标，一键安装/卸载（自动合并 cordis.patch.yml），重启生效。

s.en: Celestea series settings hub: one Settings → Celestea page listing every celestea-* namespace plugin (celes-dsh-eye, ...) with a schema form for each
Workspace launcher for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: open the current workspace as a folder or with a tool (VS Code / opencode / custom), with Windows system icons.
Hides the collapsed sidebar rail on mobile and adds DSH's native sidebar toggle to the shell.
DeepSeek Harness plugin that uses configured model providers for image analysis and context compaction.
DeepSeek Harness cost & balance plugin: hourly official-price polling (peak/off-peak ready), cache-aware per-session/per-message cost projection, and account balance via the DeepSeek API.
Plays a short chime when the agent needs a decision from you, asks a question, requests approval, or finishes a task. With a toggle and volume control.
s.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提示音插件：智能体需要选择（提问/审批）或任务完成时播放短提示音，带开关与音量设置。

s.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: restore archived sessions from an icon button in the workspace section header, backed by an overlay recovery panel.
System-prompt template injection for DeepSeek Harness: manage named prompt templates and inject the selected one (global default plus per-workspace overrides) into every session's system prompt.
A small toolbox: a stock watchlist on East Money quotes, and a local .txt novel reader that detects UTF-8 or GBK and remembers where you stopped.
s.zh: DSH 工具箱插件:股票盯盘(东方财富行情)+ 本地 txt 小说阅读器(UTF-8/GBK 自动识别、进度保存)

s.en: Local-first persistent memory infrastructure for DeepSeek Harness: bounded hot-memory bootstrap, explainable cold recall (exact + Chinese BM25), lease-lock transactional writes, read-only governance, and trajectory review. Pure Python + Markdown, zero ext
Session cost readout for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: prices every model call at DeepSeek's official peak/off-peak rates and shows the running session cost under the composer.
Fully-local OCR CLI for text-only LLMs: PaddleOCR-VL first-tier engine with tesseract fallback, dsh plugin included
Exa Search MCP for DeepSeek Harness: mounts the remote Exa MCP endpoint (https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp) through the in-box @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client bridge

A bundle of 35 skills aimed at people who do not write code — orchestration, engineering, product, and interface and launch. It is a profile bundle, not an agent preset: dsh plugin add coding-coach puts the skills into any profile. The full Coding Coach agent lives in the repository's dsh/coding-coach directory.
s.zh: 面向非开发人员的 35 个技能 bundle（DSH profile bundle，非 Agent 预设）：编排 + 工程 + 产品 + 界面/上线。dsh plugin add coding-coach 即可把技能装进任意 profile；完整「编程教练」Agent 见仓库 dsh/coding-coach 目录。

s.en: Meta package: one-command installation of the dsh-upload-button and dsh-plugin-doc-reader community plugins for DeepSeek Harness.
Sticker packs for the agent: a bundled default library (official-001, 92 images), bigram Dice semantic lookup, a send_meme tool for web and QQ, and a management panel in settings.
s.zh: DeepSeek Harness 表情包插件:内置默认图库(官方-001,92 张),bigram Dice 语义检索,send_meme 发图(Web/QQ),设置页管理面板。

s.en: MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness: manage MCP servers from the Web settings page, stored globally in $DSH_HOME/mcp-servers.json, connected/disconnected at runtime.
DSH custom appearance plugin: light/dark switch, 15 preset skins, 13 adjustable color roles and font scaling, persisted in localStorage (survives restart).

Adds a right-hand details panel with a GitHub issue map, list, skills, and environment checks, a status capsule by the composer, action injection, and handoff into a new session. It opens only in the details column, with no picture-in-picture or floating window.
s.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）上的 Waystation 控制面板插件，配合 Matt Pocock skills（github.com/mattpocock/skills）的 wayfinder / triage / grilling / handoff 等技能使用：右侧 details 列面板（GitHub issue 地图/列表/技能/环境检查）、输入区状态栏胶囊、动作注入与交接开新会话。打开形式仅右侧 details 列（无 PiP/悬浮）。npm 标准安装（postinstall 自

s.en: LX Music control: a bundled source engine with SDK search and a sandbox for source scripts, a mini player card in the sidebar, a search_and_play tool so the model can queue music, and source management in settings.
s.zh: LX Music 增强控制插件：内置音源引擎（SDK 搜索 + 音源脚本沙箱）、侧边栏迷你播放卡、LLM 点歌工具（search_and_play）、设置窗口音源管理。

s.en: dsh (DeepSeek Harness) bundle: mounts the faultseed honesty-guardrail hooks over @deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code, unmodified, via _dispatch.py
Pseudo-multimodal for dsh (Celestea series): store image attachments locally and let the model read them on demand through a vision tool (dsh_eye_read_image)
DeepSeek Harness bundle for the external Dev Flow Orchestrator MCP runtime.
DSH web input plugin: type '@' in the composer to pick workspace files/folders and insert their relative paths.
DSH web client plugin: a "最新 / Latest" button that jumps to and follows the latest conversation (and its newest message) with one click.
Semantic code search over the session workspace, indexed locally with an embedded bge-small-zh-v1.5 ONNX model, exposed to the agent as code_search.
s.zh: 代码库语义检索插件：本地索引会话工作区（bge-small-zh-v1.5 ONNX 内嵌），向 agent 注册 code_search 工具，语义定位相关代码。

s.en: Adds a Conversation | Trajectory | Diff switch to the session header, showing every change the AI made through write and edit in this session as hunk diffs, grouped by file.
s.zh: 会话更改可视化插件：在会话页头部提供'对话 | 轨迹 | DIFF'视图标签，按文件聚合展示 AI 在当前会话中通过 write/edit 工具对文件的修改（hunk diff）。

s.en: Registers deepseek-vision, a provider that declares image support and appears as "multimodal LLMs", turning pictures into text before handing them to text-only DeepSeek. The multimodal provider and model used for that conversion are configurable in settings.
s.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：注册声明支持 image 的 provider「deepseek-vision」（显示为「多模态LLMs」），把图片先转成文字再交给纯文本的 DeepSeek；转图用的多模态 provider/model 可在设置页配置。

s.en: DeepSeek Harness cordis plugin: multi-provider account balances, Coding Plan usage, daily spend and token charts (/balance /plan) with a right-side liquid-glass bubble panel

A settings form for subagents: set the default model for the main conversation and the default model, provider, and background mode for subagents. It maintains your agent preset and settings.yaml for you.
s.zh: 子代理可视化配置插件：在设置页提供表单，配置主对话默认模型与子代理默认模型/提供方/后台模式，自动维护用户 agent preset 与 settings.yaml。

s.en: DSH web port manager plugin: list all local listening ports, pick a free one, and hot-switch the DSH web port without restarting the process. 端口管理插件：查看本机已占用端口并热切换 DSH web 端口。
A life-story pipeline for dsh-Friend, producing story.md and beliefs.md.
s.zh: 人生故事流水线、story.md/beliefs.md 产物

s.en: Markdown-backed memory for dsh-Friend: memory tools, automatic summaries, and overnight consolidation.
s.zh: Markdown 记忆存储、记忆工具、自动小结、夜间归纳

s.en: The TTS seam for dsh-Friend: provider interface, queue and cache, text preprocessing, playback, and lip sync.
s.zh: TTS provider seam、队列缓存、文本预处理、播放与口型

s.en: Import Claude Code / Codex CLI conversation history into DeepSeek Harness (DSH): each conversation becomes a native DSH session under its original workspace.

DSH Web client plugin: chat content width tiers (standard / medium / wide / ultra / full) with a floating picker button. Frees wide tables from the app's hard-coded 748px content cap. UI copy follows the app language (zh / en).
A DeepSeek-logo whale for the DeepSeek Harness web UI whose water spout scales with the live token consumption rate.
Pin the Think disclosure row (expand/collapse control) to the viewport top when long reasoning text scrolls past.
Client-only dsh plugin that renders Mermaid fenced code blocks as SVG diagrams in the web UI
Translates the reasoning-effort tier names into Chinese and shows the tier for custom third-party models, which dsh does not surface by default. The chosen tier is written into the outbound request.
s.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把「推理等级」(reasoning effort) 档位名翻译成中文，并为接入的自定义第三方模型注入推理等级显示（官方 DSH 默认不注入），所选档位写入出站请求体。

s.en: An operations panel for reaching dsh over Tailscale: health checks, an HTTPS ingress switch, macOS proxy bypass, relay server maintenance, and ACL snippet generation.
s.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Tailscale 远程访问运营面板：健康检查、HTTPS 入口开关、macOS 代理绕过、中继服务器运维、ACL 片段生成。

s.en: DSH web UI top bar: single-line header layout, pill-style view switcher, and a subtler divider.
DeepSeek account balance in the dsh web sidebar footer, with live config hot reload and an editable Settings → Plugins card.
Surgical rewriting of a session's model-visible history: replace what the model sees, editing the reply and the reasoning chain separately.
s.zh: Surgical rewriting of the model-visible conversation history of a DSH session (surface replacement); edit reply and reasoning chain separately. 上下文手术刀：强制改写会话的模型可见历史，回复与思考链分开编辑。

s.en: Force-switches a session's agent preset after it has started, bypassing the lock that normally allows switching only in an empty session.
s.zh: Force-switch the agent preset (mode) of a DSH session after it has started, bypassing the blank-only lock. 会话模式强切插件：绕过「仅空白会话可切换」锁定，随时强制切换当前会话的模式。

s.en: Per-session system prompt injection: a template library, a picker per session, and a default template for new ones.
s.zh: Per-session system prompt injection for DSH: template library, per-session picker, default template for new sessions. 会话级系统提示词注入器：模板库、按会话选择、新会话默认模板。

s.en: Makes the chat conversation fill the full available width instead of the fixed column cap.
Shows the current session's estimated monetary cost in CNY as the leading item in the DeepSeek Harness status line.
Claude Code style /mcp slash command for DeepSeek Harness: list MCP servers with live status and toggle them on/off.
Quota monitor for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: OpenCode Go plan usage + DeepSeek API balance/usage, as a draggable bottom-left monitor window (host face proxies APIs, keys stay on disk).
A VS Code-style workspace file explorer with editable tabs, a floating Markdown outline, and Quick Open search.
s.zh: VS Code 风格的工作区文件浏览器 + 可编辑标签页 + Markdown 悬浮大纲 + Quick Open 搜索，DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件

s.en: An Optimise Prompt button beside the model picker that reads the current conversation and workspace files and rewrites your draft into a precise three-part prompt — goal, approach, constraints — with one-click undo.
s.zh: 提示词优化插件：模型选择左侧「优化提示词」按钮，结合当前对话与工作区文件，把草稿优化为「目标/实现措施/约束」三段式精准提示词，支持一键撤销

s.en: A microphone button in the composer: record, transcribe locally and offline with SenseVoice, and drop the text back in. Audio never leaves the machine.
s.zh: DSH WebUI 语音输入插件：输入框麦克风按钮 → 录音 → SenseVoice 本地离线转写 → 文本回填（音频不出本机）

s.en: Voice input for DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a mic button in the composer tool row that uses the browser's Web Speech API (Chrome/Edge) to transcribe speech directly into the message draft. Zero dependencies, no API keys.
Meow Eyes, a local Gemma 3 vision plugin: pictures you send are described as text automatically, and the main model can call ask_eyes to follow up on what it saw.
s.zh: 喵眼: 本地 Gemma 3 视觉插件 — 用户发图自动翻译为文字描述, 主模型可主动 ask_eyes 追问图片

s.en: Injects a Plugin Marketplace button above the settings button in the DSH Desktop sidebar (sidebar.footer.action).
s.zh: DSH Desktop 插件市场入口（sidebar.footer.action）。将「插件市场」按钮注入到 dsh 侧栏设置按钮上方。

s.en: MCP tool management: the host half connects to MCP servers and registers their tools as native model tools, while the browser half adds an MCP Servers panel to settings.
s.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 工具管理插件：宿主半边连接 MCP 服务器并把工具注册为模型原生工具，客户端半边在设置面板提供「MCP 服务器」管理界面

s.en: The voice input engine for dsh-Friend: three capture modes and a transcription proxy.
s.zh: 语音输入引擎、三种收音模式、转写代理

s.en: Persona cards for dsh-Friend: storage and retrieval, preset registration, and personality prompt sections.
s.zh: 角色卡存取、预设注册、人格提示词分区

s.en: Companion reactions for dsh-Friend: subscribes to work events, throttles them, and issues reaction commands.
s.zh: 工作陪伴事件订阅、节流、反应指令

s.en: The settings surface for dsh-Friend: a parent card, a config-centre popover, and its routing.
s.zh: 设置父卡片、配置中心小窗与路由

s.en: Lets a main model with no vision see images: pictures arriving in a session are converted to text automatically, plus a view_image tool.
s.zh: DSH 视觉桥接插件：让无视觉能力的主模型看图（会话收图 + 自动转文字 + view_image 工具）

s.en: The Microi CLI and multi-host plugin: server connections, skills, MCP, V8 sync, and low-code delivery.
s.zh: Microi吾码 AI 开发 CLI 与多宿主 Plugin：服务器连接、Skills、MCP、V8 同步和低代码交付

One-line DeepSeek Harness bundle that moves the execution world into a crash-resilient, heartbeat-kept, workspace-synced E2B sandbox.

RigorQuant for DeepSeek Harness: session-scoped unattended, context-isolated multi-agent research for empirical/computational mathematics with a four-part pre-implementation check battery and a jacobian/Lean escalation lane.

Claude Science-style research workbench for DeepSeek Harness: ReAct research-loop engine (research_* tools), versioned artifacts with provenance (artifact_* tools), and 10 science skills for genomics / pathogens / bioinformatics.

dsh Web GUI plugin for project-less chat sessions: adds a "Work outside of a project" option to the workspace picker, repairs the ungrouped group-header "+", routes new sessions to project-less mode while the current one is ungrouped, unlocks the blank un
DeepSeek Harness client plugin: session-header DeepSeek API pricing badge with live peak/off-peak prices for flash/pro and a hover price table
Component management for the dsh web UI: show and hide components, restyle them, inspect the plugin inventory, and add custom widgets.
s.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 组件管理插件：组件显隐开关、组件样式定制、插件清单查看、自定义挂件

s.en: A workspace file explorer with a resizable split tree and preview, type-based colouring, syntax highlighting, and editing, wrapped in a glass UI with a quick settings bar.
s.zh: Workspace file explorer for DeepSeek Harness Web: resizable split tree + preview layout, type-based coloring, syntax highlighting, edit/save, plus an Apple-style glass UI and quick settings bar. DSH 工作区文件浏览器:左右分栏文件预览、按类型着色、语法高亮、可编辑,附毛玻璃界面与快速设置栏。

s.en: Neo-brutalism skin for DeepSeek Harness Web UI 鈥?stacks hard-border / high-contrast --dsw-alias-* token overrides (DS-native blue + black-white + green + orange) on top of the built-in light/dark palettes.
An opencode TUI theme for the web UI: a uniform #0a0a0a ground, monospace throughout, pale violet headings, emerald inline code, One Dark syntax highlighting, and dark grey composer cards.
s.zh: DSH Web 界面 opencode TUI 主题（Client 插件）：统一 #0a0a0a 深黑背景、全等宽终端正文、淡紫标题、翠绿内联代码、One Dark 语法高亮、深灰输入框卡片。

s.en: ReelSpot screen recorder for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web GUI — header button, MP4/WebM output, mic mixing, cursor-follow zoom. Persistent composition plugin.

DeepSeek Harness (dsh) settings panel: '命令与规则' — visual rule editing, slash command list, user-defined custom command management (with {input} argument support), and backup restore (client bundle for dsh-rules-manager)

Cyberpunk 2077 / Night City theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI — NC yellow × neon cyan identity, CRT scanlines, Kiroshi hover lock-on, combat-state HUD, synthesized typewriter & message SFX, boot glitch, Relic interference, slang chips, and hidden east
DeepSeek Harness web-surface plugin: a hero character image tucked behind the composer input plus a lifted headline

Eight skins — cyber neon, soft dark, light and fresh, retro paper, midnight blue, forest green, cherry blossom, and mint — registered as system themes and selectable from the appearance dropdown, each with a full palette for the aionui panel.
s.zh: 8 款 DSH Web 皮肤（赛博霓虹/暗黑柔和/浅色清新/复古纸感/午夜蓝/森林绿/樱花粉/薄荷绿）：注册为系统级主题，外观下拉选择，含右侧 aionui 面板全套配色。
